reasons.coin-thief+priest: A thief and a priest: taking from the enemy and giving to friends can become one gesture.
reasons.gambler+hourglass: Chance meets a clock: the time rule can make the gamble certain on schedule.
reasons.mirror+trickster: Two rule-thieves: the fusion has to steal rules in a way neither parent does.
reasons.berserker+candle: Both live on missing HP: one refuses to die, the other hits harder the more it bleeds.
reasons.nautilus+thornback: The armour and the spikes: what a hit gives it and what it gives back.
reasons.magnet+prism: One pulls the allies' debuffs in, the other throws them back: a full loop.
reasons.gravecaller+raven: Two death-rules: remembering the fallen and bringing them back.
reasons.chrysalis+seed: Two slow growers: a timed metamorphosis that can pass to an ally.
reasons.hexer+sniper: Both reach the enemy's back line: silence and the shot.
reasons.bodyguard+medic: Protection two ways: take the hit or heal it.
reasons.leech+vulture: Two feeders: one drinks from strikes, the other from deaths.
reasons.hydra+lone-wolf: A contradiction: the unit that wants to be alone and the one that becomes many.
reasons.conductor+drummer: Two rhythm units: ally actions build a beat, and the beat repeats actions.
reasons.bully+frostling: Freeze sets up the Bully's double hit: a combo inside one unit.
reasons.alchemist+hornet: A poison engine: one spreads Poison, the other grows it.
reasons.fortune-teller+war-horn: Both read the board's numbers: who has more units, how few stand.
reasons.aegis+lantern: Two shields: one cancels the first hit, one works while untouched.
reasons.archmage+battery: The pool's two Charge builders: the fusion must spend Charge differently from both.
reasons.frost-witch+oracle: Two timed debuffers: Freeze on turn 2, Curse from turn 3.
reasons.executioner+gravedigger: Death as fuel: kills and fallen allies both count.

coin-thief+priest.name: Tithe Taker
coin-thief+priest.why: One battle-start gesture: bless its neighbours and curse an enemy by the same PWR; the twist cursed itself, lean A was a long Charge rule.

gambler+hourglass.name: Loaded Hour
gambler+hourglass.why: The clock makes the gamble sure on turns 3, 6, 9: both parents show in one sentence; the other two are long Charge rules.

mirror+trickster.name: Soul Harvester
mirror+trickster.why: A third creature: it keeps the rule of every enemy it sees die; Copycat Jester was almost the Trickster again.

berserker+candle.name: Last Wick
berserker+candle.why: Burns down instead of dying and lashes out with its missing HP: both parents in one rule; Waxrager sat at the band's top (75%).

nautilus+thornback.name: Spiralthorn
nautilus+thornback.why: Shortest and clearest: each hit grows its shell and curses the attacker; Recoil Chambers was a long Charge rule.

magnet+prism.name: Hexlode
magnet+prism.why: Takes the allies' debuffs and sends the same back to the giver: the full loop in one reading.

gravecaller+raven.name: Rookwraith
gravecaller+raven.why: The only one in band: keeps the fallen ally's rule, then brings the ally back a turn later.

chrysalis+seed.name: Dawnshell
chrysalis+seed.why: The metamorphosis passes to the ally behind on turn 3: a third creature; the others were a Charge heal and a plain Blessing.

hexer+sniper.name: Rearguard Thief
hexer+sniper.why: On turn 2 it takes the back enemy's rule and silences it: new, and reads at once; Dooms Marksman was a plain shot.

bodyguard+medic.name: Aegis Healer
bodyguard+medic.why: Heals the hit ally and blesses it so it survives its next death: a protector unlike either parent; Field Sentinel was Bodyguard again.

leech+vulture.name: Gorecrest
leech+vulture.why: Every strike takes power from the target and gives it to itself: a drain in one line; Carrion Drinker was only Vulture.

hydra+lone-wolf.name: Solitary Many
hydra+lone-wolf.why: When it is alone it grows Heads every other turn: the contradiction resolved; Packhydra was the Hydra with fewer heads.

conductor+drummer.name: Echo Drummer
conductor+drummer.why: Every third ally action plays again: the beat and the repeat in one rule.

bully+frostling.name: Thaw Collector
bully+frostling.why: Hits hard when an enemy's Freeze ends: a new moment to act on; Rime Brawler only alternated two statuses.

alchemist+hornet.name: Venom Distiller
alchemist+hornet.why: Turns stacked Poison into a burst each turn end: one strong reading; the twist was a Charge rule.

fortune-teller+war-horn.name: Last Stand Call
fortune-teller+war-horn.why: Rallies when the line runs thin and reads the odds for what it gives; Omen Horn sat near the band's top (72%).

aegis+lantern.name: Gleamguard
aegis+lantern.why: While untouched, its shields for the line grow with the turn; Vigil Bulwark was Bodyguard.

archmage+battery.name: Voltmage
archmage+battery.why: The hits its allies took become a storm on every enemy: spends Charge unlike either parent.

frost-witch+oracle.name: Winter Omen
frost-witch+oracle.why: Curses whoever hits it now and freezes them a turn later: a delay neither parent has.

executioner+gravedigger.name: Revenant Blade
executioner+gravedigger.why: Each kill brings a fallen ally back: death as fuel, read in one line.

discover.conductor+hourglass: two clocks: on which turns does the fusion act?
discover.mirror+raven: two rule-thieves: whose rule does the fusion end up with?
discover.gambler+lone-wolf: double strikes: what happens to the gamble?
discover.medic+nautilus: healing meets the shell: watch a hit on an ally.
discover.bully+hornet: poison and punishment: watch a poisoned enemy.
discover.gravedigger+hydra: falling heads: what does each death feed?
discover.priest+seed: slow growth and Blessing: watch the ally behind over the turns.
discover.aegis+thornback: a wall that bites: watch the first hit each turn.
discover.archmage+oracle: Charge and curses: watch from turn 3.
discover.executioner+vulture: kills feed it: watch a chain of kills.
